thesis: The page is a walk through Louisville's neighborhoods: each section is a stop on the walk, marked by a street sign that names the neighborhood and its house type, with the small fixes that house needs.

signature.name: Street Sign Marker
signature.summary: Vertical post with hanging blade sign carrying neighborhood name in slab serif and house type in mono. Brass accent border. Organizes content by place, not service category.

motion.intro: Framed hero photo swings ±3° and settles like a picture on a nail, 1.0s ease-out. Text readable at 0ms.
stories: Dotted walking path draws down the page between stops driven by --sw-p; street-sign markers flip up when path reaches them. Pinned ≥640px only.
motion.hover: Brass underline grows from left via scaleX on links and buttons.
